title: Weekend Table Reads (Saturday through Sunday)
summary: A weekend-long table reads marathon in voice chat. Everyone is welcome to read a part or just listen in. Hit Interested to save your spot, join the voice channel, and use /submit-file to submit your script. Attendees earn ScriptCoins for participating.
dateText: Every weekend, Saturday 5:00 PM PT through Sunday 5:00 PM PT
note: Join through the public Discord invite at scriptca.mp. Channel contents are not read by Scout.
